resources.string: SONIQ PRO needs Bluetooth Scan and Connect access to discover earbuds, read live battery and codec telemetry, and manage pairing. No data leaves your device.
Coarse location is used only when you request Last-Known Disconnect Location for Find Earbuds (or for BLE scanning on Android 11 and older).
Notification permission lets SONIQ PRO alert you when earbud battery drops below your threshold or when earbuds connect.
